title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗~Facade air- and water-tightness testing
focus: 以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水~Driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain
summary: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。~Starting from the forces that drive rain through a façade and the conversion of wind pressure, explain pressure-equalised rainscreens, air barriers and capillarity at joints, then turn design pressure into the test pressures and acceptance values of ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, covering mock-up testing, field sampling during installation and the time budget of AAMA 501.2 hose testing, and close with leak diagnosis, post-event re-testing and handover records, using Taipei 101, MIT's Stata Center and the British Columbia leaky-condo crisis to show what testing and design errors cost.

units.anchor: 風壓驅動水頭~Wind-driven water head
units.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓~Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure
units.mechanism: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。颱風時迎風面外部壓力高於室內，壓差會把附著在接縫上的水「吸」進牆內，甚至推過排水槽的擋水高度。因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。~For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside. In a typhoon the windward exterior pressure exceeds the interior, and the difference draws water clinging to joints into the wall or even pushes it over the dam of a drainage channel. Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work.
units.model: 風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。V = 30 m/s、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、ΔCp = 1.2：ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa，相當於水柱高 h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm；排水槽擋水高度若只有 40 mm，水就可能被推過。數值為教學假設。~Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. With V = 30 m/s, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and ΔCp = 1.2: ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa, equivalent to a water column of h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm; a drainage-channel dam only 40 mm high can be overtopped. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。~Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test.
units.failure: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。~Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop.
units.misconception: 外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。~A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
units.practice: 外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。~The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.

units.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障~Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier
units.mechanism: 壓力等化雨幕把外牆分成兩道防線：外側的雨幕擋住大部分雨水，但刻意留有通氣開口；內側的空氣屏障則必須連續且氣密。當外部風壓變化時，空氣經由通氣開口進入兩道防線之間的腔體，使腔體壓力接近外部壓力，雨幕兩側的壓差就很小，水不再被壓差推過外層接縫；真正承受壓差的是乾燥的內側空氣屏障。若空氣屏障漏氣，腔體壓力就無法建立，等化失效。英屬哥倫比亞沿海在 1990 年代大量出現的漏水公寓，調查即指出過度依賴「單層表面密封」的牆體是主因之一。~A pressure-equalised rainscreen divides the wall into two lines of defence: an outer rainscreen that stops most rain but deliberately has vents, and an inner air barrier that must be continuous and airtight. As exterior pressure changes, air flows through the vents into the cavity between them, bringing cavity pressure close to the exterior so that the pressure difference across the rainscreen is small and water is no longer pushed through its joints; the dry inner air barrier takes the pressure difference. If the air barrier leaks, cavity pressure cannot build and equalisation fails. Investigations into the leaky condominiums of coastal British Columbia in the 1990s identified reliance on face-sealed walls as a main cause.
units.model: 通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。通氣面積為屏障洩漏面積 10 倍時，雨幕只承受 1/101 ≈ 1% 的壓差；只有 5 倍時約 3.8%。若屏障洩漏增加使比值降為 2，雨幕承受 20%。數值為教學假設。~Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]. With vent area 10 times the barrier leakage area the rainscreen sees only 1/101 ≈ 1% of the pressure difference; at 5 times about 3.8%. If barrier leakage grows so the ratio falls to 2, the rainscreen sees 20%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。~Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected.
units.failure: 腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。~Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality.
units.misconception: 雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。~Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
units.practice: 外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。~Façade drawings should trace the continuous air-barrier line in colour or linetype, including its connections to slabs, roof, ground and adjacent systems; cavity compartments and vent positions are confirmed in shop drawings and the mock-up, and any break in the air barrier needs the façade consultant's approved remedy.

units.anchor: 空氣洩漏特性曲線~Air-leakage characteristic
units.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值~Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values
units.mechanism: 外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。洩漏量影響的不只是空調能耗，室內潮濕空氣冬季外洩會在牆內結露，夏季濕熱空氣內滲也會造成凝結與發霉。實驗室試驗依 ASTM E283 在指定壓差下量測單位面積洩漏量，美國帷幕牆規範常要求在 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²），但不同規範的試驗壓力不同，比較時必須換算。~Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow. Leakage affects more than HVAC energy: moist room air escaping in winter condenses inside the wall, and hot humid air infiltrating in summer also causes condensation and mould. Laboratory tests to ASTM E283 measure leakage per unit area at a specified pressure difference, and US curtain-wall specifications commonly require no more than about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf), but test pressures differ between codes, so comparisons need conversion.
units.model: Q = C·ΔP^n，取 n = 0.65。若在 75 Pa 量得 0.30 L/s·m²，換算到 300 Pa：Q = 0.30×(300/75)^0.65 = 0.30×4^0.65 ≈ 0.30×2.46 ≈ 0.74 L/s·m²，已超過 300 Pa 下 0.3 L/s·m² 的常見限值約 2.5 倍。單位換算：0.06 cfm/ft² ≈ 0.305 L/s·m²。數值為教學假設。~Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65. If 0.30 L/s·m² is measured at 75 Pa, at 300 Pa Q = 0.30×(300/75)^0.65 = 0.30×4^0.65 ≈ 0.30×2.46 ≈ 0.74 L/s·m², about 2.5 times the common limit of 0.3 L/s·m² at 300 Pa. Unit check: 0.06 cfm/ft² ≈ 0.305 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值；同時區分正壓與負壓下的洩漏，因為密封條在負壓下可能被拉開；報告中須註明試體面積、量測溫濕度與大氣壓修正。~Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit; distinguish leakage under positive and negative pressure, since gaskets may pull open under suction; the report must state specimen area and the temperature, humidity and barometric corrections.
units.failure: 把在 75 Pa 下合格的窗戶數據直接拿來比較 300 Pa 的帷幕牆規範，誤以為符合要求，完工後冬季樓板邊緣與窗框周邊出現大量結露；只測正壓而未測負壓，背風面的實際洩漏遠大於報告值。~Comparing window data that passed at 75 Pa directly with a curtain-wall specification at 300 Pa wrongly suggests compliance, and after completion heavy winter condensation appears at slab edges and around frames; testing only under positive pressure misses much larger real leakage on leeward faces.
units.misconception: 空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。~Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage.
units.practice: 規範要同時寫明允收洩漏量、試驗壓力、正負壓方向與面積計算方式，並要求提交多點壓力的洩漏曲線而非單一數字；比較不同標準（ASTM 與 EN 分級）時，由帷幕牆顧問統一換算後再判定。~The specification must state the allowable leakage, test pressure, positive and negative directions and area basis together, and require a multi-point leakage curve rather than one number; when comparing standards such as ASTM limits and EN classes, the façade consultant converts them on a common basis before judging.

units.anchor: 接縫寬度與毛細作用~Joint width and capillarity
units.title: 接縫、介面與毛細作用細部~Joints, interfaces and capillary details
units.mechanism: 外牆漏水最常發生在介面而不是材料本身：上下單元接縫、轉角、帷幕牆與石材或金屬板的交界、穿越外牆的管線與招牌錨栓，以及帷幕牆與屋頂、地坪的收邊。細小縫隙會產生毛細作用，即使沒有壓差也能把水吸進牆內；把縫隙放寬到數毫米以上、設置滴水線與毛細斷開槽，可以切斷這種驅動力。介面因為分屬不同承包商，常在圖面上只畫一條線，現場卻沒有人負責防水的連續性。~Façade leaks occur most often at interfaces rather than in the materials themselves: stack joints, corners, junctions between curtain wall and stone or metal panels, pipes and sign anchors through the wall, and the terminations of the curtain wall at roofs and grade. Fine gaps create capillary action that can draw water inward even without a pressure difference; widening gaps to several millimetres and providing drips and capillary breaks cuts off this force. Because interfaces belong to different contractors, they are often drawn as a single line while on site nobody owns the continuity of the weatherproofing.
units.model: 平行縫毛細上升高度 h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w)。γ = 0.072 N/m、θ = 0°：縫寬 w = 0.2 mm 時 h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm；w = 1 mm 時約 15 mm；w = 5 mm 時約 2.9 mm。因此毛細斷開槽通常做到數毫米寬。數值為教學假設。~Capillary rise in a parallel slot h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w). With γ = 0.072 N/m and θ = 0°: a 0.2 mm slot gives h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm; 1 mm gives about 15 mm; 5 mm gives about 2.9 mm. Capillary breaks are therefore made several millimetres wide. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 深化圖審查時逐一列出所有介面（介面清單），指定每個介面的防水與氣密負責承包商、材料與施工順序，並繪製三維節點；樣品牆必須包含最複雜的介面，現場則在介面完成時以噴水試驗抽驗，合格後才允許覆蓋。~At shop-drawing review list every interface in an interface register, assigning for each the contractor responsible for weather and air tightness, the materials and the sequence, with three-dimensional details; the mock-up must include the most complex interfaces, and on site each interface is hose-tested on completion before it may be covered.
units.failure: 帷幕牆與石材外牆交界處各自施作、彼此以為對方會處理收邊，結果只留一道表面密封膠；數年後密封膠老化龜裂，雨水經毛細作用沿石材背面流入樓板，造成大面積室內水損。~Curtain wall and stone cladding installed separately, each assuming the other will close the junction, leave only a single face sealant line; after a few years the sealant ages and cracks, and capillary action draws rain along the back of the stone onto the slab, causing extensive interior water damage.
units.misconception: 接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。~The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
units.practice: 以介面清單作為合約附件，每一個介面都有唯一負責單位與試驗要求；介面處的覆蓋前檢查設為停止點，由帷幕牆顧問或監造確認噴水試驗合格後才能封閉。~Attach the interface register to the contracts so every interface has one responsible party and a test requirement; make pre-cover inspection at interfaces a hold point, released only after the façade consultant or supervising engineer confirms a passed hose test.

units.anchor: 樣品牆試驗壓力表~Mock-up test pressure schedule
units.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力~Mock-up test planning and test pressures
units.mechanism: 實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。試驗壓力由設計風壓換算：結構試驗常以設計風壓與其 1.5 倍驗證；水密試驗則取設計風壓的一定比例並設下限。試驗順序很重要，先做結構再做水密，才能反映颱風後的真實狀態。~The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation. Test pressures derive from design pressure: structural tests commonly verify the design pressure and 1.5 times it, while water tests take a fraction of design pressure with a minimum. The sequence matters, since water tests after structural loading reflect the real condition after a typhoon.
units.model: 設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）；結構試驗 100% DP = 3.0 kPa 量測撓度、150% DP = 4.5 kPa 驗證無破壞與殘餘變形；氣密試驗 300 Pa。若 DP 降為 1.5 kPa，15% 只有 225 Pa，須改用 300 Pa 下限。數值為教學假設。~For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa); structural test at 100% DP = 3.0 kPa for deflection and 150% DP = 4.5 kPa for no failure and limited residual set; air test at 300 Pa. If DP is 1.5 kPa, 15% is only 225 Pa, so the 300 Pa minimum governs. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則；由獨立實驗室執行，業主顧問全程見證，任何修改都要記錄並納入量產圖。~Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria; an independent laboratory performs the tests with the owner's consultant witnessing throughout, and every modification is recorded and carried into production drawings.
units.failure: 樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。~A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen.
units.misconception: 樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。~A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
units.practice: 樣品牆試驗合格是量產的停止點；試驗報告要附上所有修改的照片與圖說，並由帷幕牆顧問確認修改已納入量產與安裝程序。量產第一批產品須與試驗品逐項比對。~A passed mock-up is the hold point for production; the test report must include photographs and drawings of every modification, with the façade consultant confirming they are incorporated in production and installation procedures, and the first production batch is compared item by item with the tested specimen.

units.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗~Field air and water testing during construction
units.mechanism: 實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。因為現場的試體邊界、密封條件與量測精度都不如實驗室，AAMA 503 等現場試驗規範通常把水密試驗壓力降為實驗室的三分之二，並把允許的空氣洩漏量放寬為實驗室值的 1.5 倍。現場試驗最有價值的時機是安裝初期：在第一批樓層完成時就測，可在問題擴散到整棟樓之前修正工法；之後再於中期與完工前抽驗，確認品質穩定。~The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation. Because specimen boundaries, sealing and measurement precision on site are poorer than in the laboratory, field-test standards such as AAMA 503 usually reduce the water-test pressure to two thirds of the laboratory value and relax the allowable air leakage to 1.5 times the laboratory value. The most valuable time for field testing is early: testing as soon as the first floors are complete lets workmanship be corrected before a problem spreads through the building, followed by sampling at mid-point and before completion to confirm consistent quality.
units.model: 實驗室水密 450 Pa，現場 = 2/3×450 = 300 Pa；實驗室氣密限值 0.30 L/s·m²，現場允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。若立面 30,000 m²、規定在 10%、50% 與 90% 完成時各抽驗 2 處，共 6 次；每處試驗面積約 2 個單元 12.6 m²，合計約 75.6 m²，約佔立面 0.25%。數值為教學假設。~Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa; a laboratory air limit of 0.30 L/s·m² gives a field allowance of 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². For a 30,000 m² façade with 2 tests each at 10%, 50% and 90% completion, there are 6 tests; at about 2 units or 12.6 m² each, about 75.6 m² is tested, roughly 0.25% of the façade. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏；抽驗位置由業主顧問隨機或依風險選定（含轉角與介面），不合格時找出原因、修正並擴大抽驗，所有結果納入品質紀錄。~Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage; locations are chosen by the owner's consultant at random or by risk, including corners and interfaces, and failures trigger root-cause correction and expanded sampling, with all results kept in the quality records.
units.failure: 現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修；試驗位置由施工者挑選最容易通過的單元，報告全部合格，實際使用卻持續漏水。~Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside; letting the installer choose the easiest units yields all-pass reports while the building keeps leaking in use.
units.misconception: 現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。~Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
units.practice: 合約中規定第一次現場試驗必須在安裝首批樓層後立即進行，合格前不得大量安裝；抽驗位置選定權屬業主顧問，試驗失敗的修正與擴大抽驗費用由責任方負擔。~The contract should require the first field test immediately after the first floors are installed, with no large-scale installation until it passes; the owner's consultant chooses test locations, and the responsible party bears the cost of correction and expanded sampling after a failure.

units.anchor: 試驗艙與基準洩漏~Test chamber and tare leakage
units.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀~Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation
units.mechanism: 氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。正確的程序是先以塑膠膜完全封住試體，在相同壓差下量測基準洩漏，再撕開膜量測總洩漏，兩者相減才是試體洩漏，再除以試體面積得到單位面積洩漏量。溫度、濕度與大氣壓也會影響流量計讀值，須依標準修正到標準狀態。~An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints. The correct procedure first seals the specimen completely with plastic film and measures tare leakage at the same pressure, then removes the film and measures total leakage; the difference is the specimen leakage, which is divided by specimen area to give leakage per unit area. Temperature, humidity and barometric pressure also affect flow-meter readings and must be corrected to standard conditions.
units.model: 試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。300 Pa 下總洩漏 18.0 L/s、封膜基準洩漏 4.5 L/s：試體洩漏 = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s，q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m²，超過 0.30 限值而不合格；若忘了扣除基準洩漏，誤算為 0.48 L/s·m²。數值為教學假設。~Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m². At 300 Pa total leakage is 18.0 L/s and tare leakage with the film on is 4.5 L/s: specimen leakage = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s and q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m², above the 0.30 limit, so it fails; forgetting the tare correction would give 0.48 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定；不合格時以煙筆或紅外線熱像在試體內側找出洩漏點，修正後重做，並記錄修正內容與重測結果。~Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise; after a failure locate leaks on the inner face with a smoke pencil or infrared thermography, correct them and retest, recording the corrections and new results.
units.failure: 試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。~A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass.
units.misconception: 流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。~The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
units.practice: 試驗報告必須同時列出總洩漏、基準洩漏、修正後試體洩漏、試體面積、環境條件與流量計校正證明；業主顧問應親自見證封膜與撕膜兩個步驟，避免只拿到最終數字。~The test report must list total leakage, tare leakage, corrected specimen leakage, specimen area, ambient conditions and flow-meter calibration together; the owner's consultant should witness both the sealed and unsealed steps rather than receive only the final number.

units.anchor: 噴水架與 B25 噴嘴~Spray rack and B25 nozzle
units.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗~Static, dynamic and field hose water tests
units.mechanism: 水密試驗有三種主要形式：ASTM E331 在外側以噴水架均勻噴水，同時在試體兩側維持靜態壓差 15 分鐘；AAMA 501.1 以大型螺旋槳風機產生紊動風與噴水，模擬颱風的動態壓力與風雨，檢查壓力等化系統在脈動下是否有效；AAMA 501.2 則是在現場以手持噴嘴對已安裝的接縫直接噴水，沒有壓差，只檢查接縫與介面的施工品質。三者各有角色，不能互相取代：現場噴水合格不代表系統在壓差下不漏。~Water tests take three main forms: ASTM E331 sprays the exterior uniformly from a spray rack while holding a static pressure difference across the specimen for 15 minutes; AAMA 501.1 uses a large propeller wind generator with spray to create turbulent wind and rain, simulating the dynamic pressures of a typhoon and checking whether pressure equalisation works under pulsation; AAMA 501.2 sprays installed joints on site with a hand-held nozzle and no pressure difference, checking only the workmanship of joints and interfaces. Each has its role and none replaces another: passing a field hose test does not mean the system stays dry under pressure.
units.model: 噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。AAMA 501.2 以 B25 #6.030 噴嘴、噴嘴處 30 psi（約 207 kPa），每 5 ft（約 1.52 m）接縫噴 5 分鐘：抽驗 200 m 接縫需 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min，約 10.9 小時。抽驗長度為教學假設。~Spray-rate conversion: 5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min. AAMA 501.2 uses a B25 #6.030 nozzle at 30 psi (about 207 kPa) at the nozzle, spraying 5 minutes per 5 ft (about 1.52 m) of joint: checking 200 m of joints takes 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min, about 10.9 hours. The sampled length is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力；現場噴水試驗須由外到內安排觀察員，從最低的接縫開始向上逐段噴水，記錄每段的時間、位置與是否滲水，並以照片標示；允收準則（例如內側不得出現未受控制的水）須事先定義。~Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure; for field hose tests station an observer inside, spray joint segments from the lowest upward, record time, position and any leakage for each segment, and mark them on photographs; the acceptance criterion, such as no uncontrolled water on the interior, must be defined beforehand.
units.failure: 現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。只做靜態試驗的系統，在颱風的陣風脈動下等化失效而漏水。~Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located; using an ordinary hose at uncontrolled pressure makes results unrepeatable; a system tested only statically may lose equalisation under typhoon gust pulsation and leak.
units.misconception: 現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。~If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
units.practice: 規範要分別指定實驗室靜態、動態與現場噴水試驗的適用範圍與允收準則，並規定現場噴水使用標準噴嘴與壓力錶；每次試驗由業主顧問見證並簽認紀錄。~The specification should state separately the scope and acceptance criteria for laboratory static, dynamic and field hose tests, and require a standard nozzle and pressure gauge on site; the owner's consultant witnesses and signs each test record.

units.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任~Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability
units.mechanism: 使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。診斷要從資料開始：漏水時的風向、雨量與持續時間，再以分段噴水由下往上隔離可疑接縫，搭配紅外線熱像、含水率計與局部拆檢找出入口。小量長期滲漏比偶發的大量漏水更危險，因為它在牆內持續累積，造成金屬腐蝕、隔熱層失效與發霉。英屬哥倫比亞沿海的漏水公寓危機與麻省理工學院 Stata 中心的漏水訴訟，都顯示外牆水密失敗最後會變成昂貴的修復與法律責任。~The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears. Diagnosis starts with data on wind direction, rainfall and duration during leaks, then isolates suspect joints by segment-by-segment spraying from the bottom up, with infrared thermography, moisture meters and local opening-up to find the entry point. Small long-term leaks are more dangerous than occasional large ones because they accumulate inside the wall, corroding metal, degrading insulation and causing mould. The leaky-condominium crisis in coastal British Columbia and the leak litigation over MIT's Stata Center both show that façade watertightness failures end in costly repairs and legal liability.
units.model: 一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L；若牆內只能以蒸發排出每年 15 L，淨累積 25 L/年，5 年後約 125 L 留在牆內。分段隔離 6 條可疑接縫，每段噴水 5 分鐘並觀察 10 分鐘，需 6×(5 + 10) = 90 分鐘。數值為教學假設。~A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year; if the wall can dry only 15 L a year by evaporation, 25 L accumulates each year, about 125 L after 5 years. Isolating 6 suspect joints with 5 minutes of spray and 10 minutes of observation each takes 6×(5 + 10) = 90 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口；修補後在相同條件下複驗，並以含水率計或感測器追蹤牆內乾燥；重大漏水案件須由獨立外牆顧問出具調查報告。~Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors; serious cases need an investigation report by an independent façade consultant.
units.failure: 管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。~Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding.
units.misconception: 在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。~Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.
units.practice: 保固期內的每一次漏水都要依程序調查並記錄根因，不得只做表面補修；涉及設計或系統性施工缺陷時，業主、設計者與承包商須依合約啟動責任判定程序，並保留所有試驗與調查證據。~Every leak during the warranty period must be investigated by procedure with the root cause recorded, not merely patched; where design or systematic workmanship defects are involved, owner, designer and contractor must start the contractual liability process and preserve all test and investigation evidence.

units.anchor: 事件後複驗與竣工基準~Post-event retest and baseline
units.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接~Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover
units.mechanism: 外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。台北 101 的外牆系統公開資料指出可承受約 95 mm 的側向地震位移而不損壞，這類設計能力需要以層間位移後再做水密試驗的程序驗證，也提醒管理者在大事件後應檢查接縫與密封是否位移。交接時應建立性能基準：試驗報告、現場抽驗結果、介面清單與漏水紀錄格式，讓日後的複驗能與原始狀態比較。~Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations. Public information on Taipei 101 states that its façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage; such capacity must be proven by a procedure that repeats the water test after racking, and it reminds managers to check joints and seals for displacement after major events. Handover should establish a performance baseline of test reports, field results, the interface register and the leak-log format so that later re-tests can be compared with the original state.
units.model: 若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。事件後若監測到某些樓層變位角超過 0.5%，在這些樓層的 2% 接縫長度做現場噴水複驗：每層接縫 2,000 m 時抽驗 40 m，以每 1.52 m 噴 5 分鐘計約 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 分鐘。層高與接縫長度為教學假設。~Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%. If monitoring after an event shows some floors exceeded 0.5% drift, hose-test 2% of joint length on those floors: with 2,000 m of joints per floor, test 40 m, about 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 minutes at 5 minutes per 1.52 m. The storey height and joint lengths are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。~Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database.
units.failure: 大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水；交接時沒有留下試驗報告與介面清單，後續維修單位無法判斷原設計的排水路徑而誤封排水孔。~After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season; without test reports and the interface register at handover, later maintenance contractors cannot tell the intended drainage paths and seal the weep holes by mistake.
units.misconception: 外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。~A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
units.practice: 竣工交接應包含樣品牆與現場試驗報告、介面清單、排水路徑圖、密封材資料與更換週期、漏水紀錄格式與事件後檢查程序；任何外牆穿孔、加掛設備或改裝前，須經帷幕牆顧問評估水密影響並由業主核准。~Handover should include mock-up and field test reports, the interface register, drainage-path drawings, sealant data and renewal intervals, the leak-log format and the post-event inspection procedure; before any penetration, added equipment or alteration of the façade, the façade consultant must assess the watertightness impact and the owner must approve.

example: 設計練習：某 40 層辦公塔外牆面積 30,000 m²，風洞試驗得標準區設計風壓 DP = 2.4 kPa、角隅區 3.6 kPa。標準區水密試驗壓力取 15% DP = 360 Pa（高於 300 Pa 下限），角隅區 540 Pa；結構試驗 150% DP 分別為 3.6 kPa 與 5.4 kPa；氣密試驗 300 Pa、限值 0.30 L/s·m²。樣品牆 37.8 m²：總洩漏 15.0 L/s、基準洩漏 4.5 L/s，試體洩漏 10.5 L/s，q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m²，合格。現場抽驗：水密壓力 2/3×360 = 240 Pa（標準區），氣密允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。540 Pa 相當於水柱 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm，角隅區橫框擋水高度至少要大於此值並留餘裕。若角隅區改以 20% DP 試驗，壓力升為 720 Pa，水柱約 73 mm，擋水需相應加高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a 40-storey office tower has 30,000 m² of façade, and wind-tunnel testing gives design pressures DP = 2.4 kPa in typical zones and 3.6 kPa at corners. Water-test pressure is 15% DP = 360 Pa for typical zones (above the 300 Pa minimum) and 540 Pa at corners; structural tests at 150% DP are 3.6 kPa and 5.4 kPa; the air test is at 300 Pa with a 0.30 L/s·m² limit. Mock-up of 37.8 m²: total leakage 15.0 L/s, tare 4.5 L/s, specimen 10.5 L/s, q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m², a pass. Field sampling: water at 2/3×360 = 240 Pa in typical zones, air allowance 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². 540 Pa equals a water column of 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm, so corner transom dams must exceed this with margin. If corners are instead tested at 20% DP, the pressure rises to 720 Pa, a column of about 73 mm, and the dams must rise accordingly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 外牆水密的現代理解來自「雨幕原理」：讓外層通氣、使腔體壓力接近外部，壓差由內側乾燥的空氣屏障承擔。北美在 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列中建立了實驗室與現場試驗方法，歐洲則以 EN 12153、EN 12155 等標準與 EN 13830 分級。1980 至 2000 年代初英屬哥倫比亞沿海大量公寓漏水，1998 年 Barrett 委員會指出過度依賴表面密封的牆體，促成當地規範要求雨幕構造；2004 年啟用的麻省理工學院 Stata 中心在 2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解；同年代完工的台北 101 則公開其外牆可承受約 95 mm 側向位移。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The modern understanding of façade watertightness comes from the rainscreen principle: vent the outer layer so cavity pressure approaches exterior pressure, leaving the pressure difference to a dry inner air barrier. North America established laboratory and field test methods in ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, while Europe uses standards such as EN 12153 and EN 12155 with classification under EN 13830. From the 1980s to the early 2000s large numbers of condominiums in coastal British Columbia leaked; in 1998 the Barrett Commission identified reliance on face-sealed walls, leading local codes to require rainscreen construction. MIT's Stata Center, opened in 2004, became the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other problems, settled in 2010, while Taipei 101, completed in the same era, states publicly that its façade can take about 95 mm of lateral displacement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: ASTM E331 靜態水密試驗在噴水與壓差同時作用下持續 15 分鐘~ASTM E331 holds spray and static pressure together for 15 minutes
AAMA 501.1 以直徑 84 in（約 2.1 m）的螺旋槳風機與每小時每平方英尺 5 加侖噴水進行 15 分鐘動態水密試驗~AAMA 501.1 uses an 84 in (about 2.1 m) propeller wind generator and 5 gal/ft²·h spray for a 15-minute dynamic water test
5 gal/ft²·h 噴水量約等於 3.4 L/m²·min~A spray rate of 5 gal/ft²·h equals about 3.4 L/m²·min
AAMA 501.2 現場噴水以 B25 #6.030 噴嘴在噴嘴處 30 psi（約 207 kPa），每 5 ft 接縫噴 5 分鐘~AAMA 501.2 field hose testing uses a B25 #6.030 nozzle at 30 psi (about 207 kPa), 5 minutes per 5 ft of joint
美國帷幕牆規範常要求 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下空氣洩漏不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²）~US curtain-wall specifications commonly limit air leakage to about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf)
AAMA 503 等現場試驗常把水密壓力取實驗室的 2/3、空氣洩漏允許值放寬為 1.5 倍~Field tests such as AAMA 503 commonly use 2/3 of the laboratory water pressure and 1.5 times the laboratory air allowance
英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機波及超過 900 棟建築、約 31,000 戶~The British Columbia leaky-condo crisis affected over 900 buildings and about 31,000 housing units
台北 101 外牆系統公開資料稱可承受約 95 mm 側向地震位移而不損壞~Public information states that Taipei 101's façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage
麻省理工學院 Stata 中心 2004 年啟用，2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解~MIT's Stata Center opened in 2004, was the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other defects, and settled in 2010
